chunk_findings.detail: `_delta_on` returns `review_toml` unchanged when both `delta_default` and `max_rounds` already appear anywhere in the string. If a caller passes a tableless review fragment, e.g. `_setup(repo, tmp_path, review_toml="delta_default = false\nmax_rounds = 2\n")`, the function does not wrap it in `[review]`. `_setup` then appends that fragment after the `[[reviewer]]` table, so those keys become keys of the reviewer table rather than `[review]`; the intended `review.delta_default = false` is not applied (or the parser rejects unknown reviewer keys). The function otherwise prepends `[review]` for tableless fragments when it needs to add a default, so this early-return branch is inconsistent and can produce the wrong effective configuration.
chunk_findings.title: tests/review_delta_support.py:28

chunk_findings.detail:
`_delta_on` detects an existing review section only by the exact substring `"[review]
"`. For input such as `review_toml = "[review]"`, or a CRLF fragment like `"[review]
max_rounds = 2
"`, it takes the no-section branch and prepends another `[review]` table. The resulting config written by `_setup` contains duplicate `[review]` sections, e.g. `[review]
delta_default = true
max_rounds = 0
[review]`, which is invalid TOML/duplicate-table input and can make setup fail.

chunk_findings.detail: The split moves tests into sibling modules (`tests/test_review_delta_findings.py` and `tests/test_review_delta_surfaces.py`), but `tests/test_review_delta.py` does not act as the stated facade: it only imports helper symbols from `review_delta_support` and never imports/re-exports the moved test modules. As a result, the old path no longer contains the moved tests; for example, `pytest tests/test_review_delta.py` will no longer collect `test_a_delta_finding_is_numbered_by_its_place_in_the_record` (manifest says that test is added to `tests/test_review_delta_findings.py`), silently changing test selection versus the pre-split behaviour.
chunk_findings.title: tests/test_review_delta.py:14

chunk_findings.detail: In the hunk that removes this test, the line `out = _review(repo)  # unchanged since the reviewed head; nothing held a clean pass` is not marked for deletion while the enclosing `def` and surrounding body lines are. After applying the patch, this assignment is left in `tests/test_review_delta.py` outside any function, so importing/collecting the test module executes `_review(repo)` at module scope where `repo` is not defined, causing a collection-time NameError (or an IndentationError if the original function indentation is preserved). This breaks test collection for the split test module.
